name: Session Bridge
description: 跨会话桥：同项目的多个会话可在侧栏群聊室中互相提问、委托与回传结论。

agentTools.name: bridge_sessions
agentTools.description: List sessions in the current project (prioritizing running and recent sessions) so you can pick target sessions for cross-session questions.

activeOnly.description: Only return currently running/busy sessions or sessions that took part in the bridge room within the last 30 minutes (default false)

query.description: Optional keyword to filter sessions by title or id

agentTools.name: bridge_ask
agentTools.description: Ask one or more sessions in the same project a question via the Session Bridge group chat. Opens the Session Bridge side panel and either waits for their replies (wait=true, default) or delivers them back asynchronously.

targets.description: Target session IDs or title keywords (from bridge_sessions)

question.description: Question or request to send to the target sessions

wait.description: Wait for all target sessions to reply and return their answers directly (default true)

agentTools.name: bridge_reply
agentTools.description: Send an explicit reply back to a cross-session question in the Session Bridge group chat.

requestId.description: Optional request ID from the incoming bridge question; defaults to the latest pending question for this session

reply.description: Concise answer or conclusion to send back

agentTools.name: bridge_history
agentTools.description: Read recent cross-session group chat messages in the current project.
